title: Feature request : add the possibility to inject later (or set a reminder alert)
body:
I'm a _slow CHO digesting_ person. Which results in low BGs if I inject insulin at the start of meals. I note carbs input in AAPS and start the meal and I use the calculator towards the end of the meal to inject insulin.

It would be useful if in the calculator I could set either a _wait x minutes before injection_ option or, if it is not easy to add this option, be able to set an alert for a _reminder in x minutes_ to inject insulin
